items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: So I worked the whole show the whole year with him, and he even recorded Caravan.

ctx.x: I did the whole -- because him and his wife and family, we were all very good friends, you know; we used to go to their house or they used to come here for dinner or something like that. We were very good friends. So he put me in the show with the band in the studio, and in a way, the studio trombone player couldn't work because Nat Cole put me in there, you know?
So I worked the whole show the whole year with him, and he even recorded Caravan.
